summary:
Frontend-only E2E test of the new WYSIWYG compose editor in the Email track (/studio/email/email-m9 'Formatting Emails') as explorer em-exp (cookie session_token injection worked: add_cookies BEFORE goto, domain explorer-journey-4.preview.emergentagent.com, httpOnly+secure+sameSite None). BOTH USER-REPORTED BUGS ARE FIXED: (1) BOLD is real WYSIWYG - clicking [email-fmt-bold] with a selection (Shift+ArrowLeft x5 on 'early') and with NO selection then typing both produce real markup (innerHTML: 'The rehearsal is at 4 PM sharp...'), and NO literal '**' is ever visible in the editor. (2) BULLETS continue on Enter - clicking [email-fmt-bullets], typing 'Bring your instrument', Enter, typing again yields TWO real
  • items ['Bring your instrument','Wear the blue shirt']; Enter on an empty bullet exits the list (verified caret is no longer inside an LI). Bullet button also converts an existing non-empty line into a bullet (verified on mobile 390x844). Signature button inserts the em-dash signature ('— / Jordan Rivera / Horizon Middle School'). GRADING REGRESSION PASSES: composed To team@horizonmiddle.edu + greeting + bold time + 2-item bullet list + signature (>12 words), Send -> Submit for a grade => Mission Graded 'A', Score 100%, 6/6 tasks, all of t1-t6 render studio-task--done (t2 bold, t3 bullets, t4 signature detected from the serialized '**'/'• '/'—' markers). Writing Coach on compose works: with a mis-spelled sentence, [email-check-writing-btn] produced [email-writing-tips] with 10 issues (text -> suggestion - message, e.g. recieve -> received) plus a warning toast. Drafts round-trip: bold + 2 bullets saved and reopened as real formatting (1 , 2
  • , no raw '**' or '•' characters). Reply/Reply-All/Forward keep the quoted original, the editor stays editable (typed above the quote) and sending works. Regressions clean: inbox open/read, reading pane, search 'lunch' filters to 1 result, ZERO console/page errors on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 (the only 4xx seen, two 401 /api/auth/me, come from the automation tool's own pre-cookie first navigation, not the app - curl with the cookie returns 200).

ui_bugs.issue:
MISSING NEWLINE BUG: a leading bare text node (the first typed line, which the browser leaves outside any <div>) is concatenated with the following block with no '
'. Typed 'Hi Team,' + Enter + 'Our concert starts at ...' serializes to 'Hi Team,Our concert starts at ...' - the sent email in the reading pane and the reopened draft both show the greeting glued to the first sentence ('Hello team here is the plan for todayMeet at 4 PM'). Fix: in serializeNode, before emitting a block element (div/p/ul/ol/li), if out is non-empty and does not end with '
', prepend '
'.

The reading pane still renders the serialized markdown literally, so after sending, the student sees '**6:30 PM on Friday**' and '• ' markers - the exact literal-asterisk confusion the user complained about, now moved from compose to the Sent view. Consider rendering the stored body with textToHtml() (or a read-only formatted view) in the reading pane.

LOW: after bolding a SELECTION, the caret is left inside the <b>, so everything typed afterwards (including subsequent bullets) stays bold and serializes as '**...**'. Browser-native behaviour, but for 7th graders it made a whole bullet list bold in one test run. Optional: a toolbar active-state indicator so students can see Bold is ON.

issues: Toolbar buttons have no active/pressed state, so Bold ON vs OFF is invisible.
Signature insertion adds a large blank gap (2-3 empty lines) before the em dash because the caret was left after an exited list; cosmetic only.

action_items: Fix the serializer newline gap: prepend '\n' before a block element when the accumulated output does not already end with a newline (greeting currently merges with the first sentence in sent mail and reopened drafts).
Optional/MEDIUM: render bold/bullets as formatting in the reading pane instead of showing raw '**' and '• ' to the student.
Optional/LOW: show an active state on the Bold/Bullets toolbar buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: RichBody sets innerHTML only once on mount (empty dep array) and is keyed by compose._id - correct, avoids caret-jumping re-renders. Good.

serializeNode handles //,
  • ,
      /

        ; the only gap is the missing leading-newline before a block (see ui_bugs).

bodyIssues (writing tips) is not reset in startCompose/editDraft/close; it happened to be cleared in my runs, but a stale tips panel from a previous message can persist - reset setBodyIssues([]) when a compose opens/closes.

escapeHtml is applied in textToHtml and in the signature insert - no XSS path from typed text; execCommand('styleWithCSS', false) keeps output as <b> rather than styled spans (confirmed in the browser).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested scenarios pass (bold WYSIWYG, bullet Enter continuation + exit, signature, grading A 6/6, writing tips, draft round-trip, reply/forward, search/read regressions, no console errors); 2 medium cosmetic/serialization defects found

seed_data_creation: Sent 3 emails and saved 1 draft inside em-exp's email-m9 studio doc; submitted email-m9 once (graded A, +100 HP, +1 mark). No other data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth that works: page.context.add_cookies([{name:'session_token', value:'em_exp_tok', domain:'explorer-journey-4.preview.emergentagent.com', path:'/', httpOnly:True, secure:True, sameSite:'None'}]) BEFORE page.goto - the tool's own initial navigation to page_url happens un-authenticated (that is the 401 /api/auth/me in the console). Rich editor: type with page.keyboard.type into [data-testid=email-body]; select words with Shift+ArrowLeft; assert on innerHTML (<b>) and querySelectorAll('li'). Grading takes ~15-40s (writing gate + AI) - wait up to 90s for [data-testid=studio-result-grade].
rca_of_the_issue: Both reported defects are genuinely fixed by the contentEditable RichBody: execCommand('bold') yields a real <b> (styleWithCSS off) so students never see '**' while composing, and because bullets are a native <ul>/<li>, the browser itself continues the list on Enter and exits on an empty item. The serializer keeps grading intact (hasBold via '**', hasBullets via '• ', hasSignature via '—') - confirmed end-to-end with an A/100%/6-of-6 result. The one remaining serialization defect is that serializeNode does not insert a newline when a block element follows a bare leading text node, so the first line merges with the second in the plain-text body that is stored, displayed in the reading pane and re-parsed for drafts.
